notes: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse, printed: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, ...' The count is per turn. In turn 1 I draw one card (a Crash Through); the turn passes through the opponent's turn 2 to my turn 3, where my draw step gives me my FIRST card of that turn. Two cards drawn over two turns are no second card of any turn: no Cat.
